components.name: Add to cart
components.description: Default large native cart command; this self-contained preview preserves its default presentation without cart persistence. Source: elements/yuva-add-to-cart.js and templates/yuva-add-to-cart.template.html. Saving uses the authored Adding… label, an interrupted-circle indicator rotating at 700ms linear, and disabled activation to prevent duplicate additions. Reduced motion removes the rotation. Success changes the plus to a check and opens a native auto nonmodal popover at the lower trailing viewport corner, named by the authored Added to your cart. heading, with the actual owner product photo and title, its saved quantity, and the total View cart count. Keep browsing and Escape close it and return focus; outside activation light-dismisses it without taking focus. The existing dur-slowest / ease-out opacity and space-7 translation animate entry and exit with discrete display / overlay transitions; reduced motion removes them. Authored errors remain visible below the command; the success announcement is visually hidden to avoid layout shift.

narrative.overview:
Room studies gives Yuva generous photographic space, weighty sans-serif headings, and a quiet
setting for inspecting furniture and home objects. Cream and plum frame the photography; rust
marks the principal actions. Flat surfaces, square imagery, fine dividers, and restrained motion
keep the objects and authored text legible.

This document extracts the implemented storefront. The organization-owned
[styles.css](design-system/styles.css), [fonts.css](design-system/fonts.css), and native custom
element modules remain the source of truth. Frontmatter records their observed values and selected
component presentations; it does not replace the canonical Design System or create new public CSS
variables. The Room studies homepage is one expression of these foundations. Its grouped hero copy,
distinct lead photograph, and unequal featured objects are not mandatory layouts for every custom
element.
Component `height` entries record the source minimum block size, allowing labels to wrap or grow.
keyCharacteristics: Generous photography and contained product images with their original proportions.
Source Sans 3 for the storefront's principal headings, body copy, and controls.
Source Serif 4 retained for selected prices, cart titles, and totals.
Square actions, quiet dividers, and filled selection states with separate focus outlines.
Content-responsive layouts and motion that respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Color Scheme Rule
rules.body: Consume the existing semantic CSS roles and let `color-scheme` resolve their `light-dark()` values.

rules.name: The Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Preserve the implemented DOM sequence when a layout changes; gallery mode controls precede the image or spin stage at every width.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Decorative transforms, menu entry, and disclosure transitions are removed when reduced motion is requested; reading, gallery selection, and manual inspection remain available.

dos: Do consume the canonical semantic CSS properties and native color-scheme resolution.
Do use the observed sans-serif storefront heading roles while retaining serif prices and cart typography where the component source uses them.
Do keep product photographs contained and preserve their white inspection field in both color schemes.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and separate from filled selected states.
Do preserve responsive DOM order, authored text, Slots, references, and manual gallery controls when extending a component.
Do respect reduced motion and keep the complete reading and interaction sequence available.
donts: Don't turn the homepage's paired copy and photograph, sticky introduction, or 3fr / 2fr stagger into a required layout for every reusable custom element.
Don't substitute new colors or inferred swatch ramps for the canonical CSS values.
Don't replace real product photographs or authored facts with decorative substitutes.
Don't make selection depend on a persistent side rail or keyboard focus depend on animation.
Don't promote dormant eyebrow styling or unrelated library variants into the storefront's required visual grammar.
